reason: Repair internal GitHub source job execution with fenced PostgreSQL checkpoints, bounded per-repository slices, quota-aware continuation and browser-only running progress. Existing named collection, job polling, results and idempotency operations retain their request/response projections, scopes and repository boundaries. No provider grant, saved connection configuration or new public operation is introduced.

cli.reason: Existing generic and typed collection/job/result commands and login scopes are unchanged; resumability is internal durable execution.

gateway.reason: The fixed Platform adapter continues to use the same guarded collect/job/results operations and safe projections. No Platform source, schema or app-specific enhancement is needed.
